title: DevOps Engineer
description:
About the Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced a DevOps Engineer to support the transition of a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) backend system from a Proof of Concept (PoC) to a scalable, production-ready platform.

This role will focus on building, configuring, and deploying a serverless architecture leveraging AWS Bedrock, Lambda, API Gateway, RDS PostgreSQL, and other managed services.

You will collaborate closely with RedTeam’s existing .NET backend team to integrate a new Backend RAG API Service , enabling semantic search on construction specification documents through existing frontend applications.


Responsibilities

Infrastructure Provisioning

  • Execute curated deployment scripts using the AWS SDK.
  • Provision the full serverless architecture: API Gateway, Lambda, RDS (PostgreSQL), VPC components, and Bedrock Knowledge Base .

API Gateway Configuration

  • Deploy and configure RESTful API endpoints for chat query orchestration.
  • Ensure correct integration with the customer’s .NET API, where authentication/authorization is handled (no native AWS auth).

AWS Lambda Deployment

  • Deploy the API Orchestrator Lambda and the Ingestion & KB Sync Lambda functions.
  • Ensure Lambdas run inside the VPC and can be invoked by the customer’s .NET backend.

Networking & Security

  • Configure VPC networking, subnets, and access control for RDS connections.
  • Implement pragmatic least-privilege IAM policies for all components.

S3 Integration Setup

  • Configure Amazon S3 as the corpus data source for the AWS Bedrock Knowledge Base.
  • Enable automatic synchronization between the S3 bucket and the Knowledge Base.

Database Deployment

  • Deploy and configure the Amazon RDS PostgreSQL instance for chat history and conversation memory.
  • Execute necessary DDL changes and schema configuration.

Observability Setup

  • Configure CloudWatch logs and alarms for monitoring, troubleshooting, and operational health.


Required Qualifications

  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS Serverless Architecture (Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB or RDS).
  • Experience provisioning AWS environments using AWS SDK, IaC scripts, or automated deployment pipelines .
  • Proficiency with VPC networking, IAM security policies , and integrating private Lambdas with RDS.
  • Knowledge of RDS (PostgreSQL) administration and schema deployment.
  • Experience with CloudWatch for logging, metrics, and alarm configuration.
  • Ability to integrate backend services with external APIs, especially .NET-based systems.


Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures.
  • Familiarity with AWS Bedrock , Bedrock Knowledge Base, and generative AI workloads.
  • Working knowledge of semantic search , embeddings, or vector-based search systems.
  • Experience with .NET backend integration or hybrid cloud/backend environments.
  • Exposure to infra-as-code tools (CloudFormation, CDK, Terraform).
  • Background in serverless best practices , scalability, and production hardening.

A NARI Brasil é uma empresa integrante ao NARI Group Corporation, líder no fornecimento de equipamentos para o setor de energia elétrica na China. Fundado em 1973, o grupo NARI dedica-se a oferecer tecnologias de ponta.

Desde sua fundação no Brasil em 2013 com suas operações em Sorocaba-SP, a NARI Brasil tem se destacado no desenvolvimento e comercialização de sistemas de controle e proteção de subestações, com foco em soluções inovadoras e de alta qualidade.

title: Executivo de Vendas Externas - Máquina de cartão - Mercado Pago - MG
description:
No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito!


Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.

Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico.

Para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.

Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques.

Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.


Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:


  • Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.
  • Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão.
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.


Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:


  • Representar o Mercado Pago em uma Região: percorrer áreas comerciais (loja a loja), identificar oportunidades, entender as necessidades dos lojistas e oferecer soluções personalizadas com os produtos e serviços do Mercado Pago (foco em maquininha de cartão).
  • Prospectar de forma estratégica: realizar abordagens porta a porta, 100% presenciais, com planejamento, disciplina e eficiência, superando metas e maximizando a satisfação das empresas credenciadas.
  • Garantir um excelente pós-venda: acompanhar o onboarding das empresas credenciadas, garantindo a ativação imediata, engajamento e principalidade de relacionamento com o Mercado Pago.
  • Competir em Equipe para Ganhar: participar ativamente das reuniões e demais atividades em equipe, compartilhando boas práticas, ideias inovadoras, contribuindo para a maximização dos resultados individuais e coletivos.


Requisitos:


  • Possuir formação superior completa ou estar cursando.
  • Possuir CNH \"B” e Automóvel próprio (4 rodas) para uso diário.
  • Ter experiência consistente em vendas porta a porta (vendas externas).
  • Possuir disponibilidade para trabalhar nas regiões de atuação.


Nós lhe propomos:


  • Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo.
  • Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores.
  • Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas.
  • Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência. :)



O Mercado Livre não faz contato oferecendo oportunidades em troca de pagamento de dinheiro. Você tem acesso a todas as oportunidades abertas no nosso site de carreiras. Caso receba pedidos de dinheiro, desconfie!

  • Develop, optimize, and maintain efficient, production-ready SQL queries, leveraging advanced techniques such as Common Table Expressions (CTEs) and window functions.

  • Collaborate closely with Data Engineering teams to understand and leverage the underlying data warehouse structure (e.g., Python, SQL).

  • Champion a high-end aesthetic in all data products, focusing on design principles that enhance data comprehension and drive user adoption.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • Aesthetic and Design Acumen: Ability to translate complex analytical findings into beautiful, polished, and intuitive visualizations, evidenced by a strong public portfolio.

Requirements:

  • Advanced Proficiency in Shiny for Python: Deep expertise in developing, deploying, and managing production-grade Shiny applications, including a solid understanding of reactivity principles, modular design, and front-end styling.
  • Expert BI Tool Experience: Strong, hands-on experience with Looker Studio, particularly in data blending, custom calculations, and connecting to various data sources.
  • Advanced SQL Skills: Demonstrated ability to write complex, performant SQL queries (using CTEs, window functions, and advanced joins) for data manipulation and preparation prior to visualization.


Nice-to-haves:

  • Familiarity with other data visualization libraries in Python (e.g., Plotly, Dash) to complement Shiny.
  • Experience with other BI platforms (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) is a plus.
  • Experience in the higher education or SaaS technology sectors.


Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent professional life/work experience in a quantitative or technical field.
  • 3+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in a role focused on data visualization development, BI reporting, or data product creation, preferably within a fast-paced technology or SaaS environment.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Como Senior Data Engineer na área de Analytics & IA da Sankhya, você terá a missão de projetar, desenvolver e manter soluções escaláveis de dados, desenhar arquiteturas eficientes, garantir governança, segurança e alta performance. Atuará em colaboração com squads multidisciplinares, impulsionando inovação e contribuindo para a evolução da BIA e dos produtos inteligentes da Sankhya.



RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Definir e implementar arquiteturas de dados escaláveis e resilientes, suportando operações em larga escala.
  • Atuar na modernização da stack de dados, avaliando novas tecnologias e frameworks.
  • Construir e manter plataformas de dados para suportar produtos analíticos e de inteligência artificial.
  • Garantir a qualidade e integridade dos dados, implementando processos robustos de validação, auditoria e monitoramento.
  • Trabalhar na orquestração de pipelines, utilizando ferramentas como Apache Airflow.
  • Implementar soluções serverless e arquiteturas distribuídas, otimizando custo e performance.
  • Atuar na governança e segurança de dados, garantindo conformidade com regulamentações (LGPD, GDPR).
  • Desenvolver e manter APIs e data products para integração entre sistemas internos e externos.
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com Product Managers e Data Scientists para transformar dados em insights estratégicos.
  • Monitorar tendências tecnológicas e de mercado, propondo inovações alinhadas às necessidades do negócio.



REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Proficiência avançada em SQL e otimização de queries.
  • Domínio em Python, Scala e/ou Java para manipulação e processamento de dados.
  • Sólida experiência em Cloud Computing (AWS, Azure, GCP) e seus serviços de dados.
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL (PostgreSQL, Cassandra, DynamoDB).
  • Conhecimento avançado em Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, OpenTofu, CloudFormation).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de orquestração de workflows (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect).
  • Conhecimento avançado em monitoramento, logging e observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, AWS CloudWatch).
  • Experiência na implementação de DataOps, CI/CD e automação de deploys.
  • Domínio de segurança e compliance de dados (LGPD, GDPR, ISO 27001).
  • Experiência na criação de produtos de dados e APIs escaláveis para consumo interno e externo.
  • Experiência avançada com Data Governance e Catalogação de Dados (Data Catalog, Apache Atlas, Collibra).
  • Vivência em arquitetura orientada a eventos e soluções de baixa latência.

title: Senior Java Developer
description:

title: Global Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as University of São Paulo, UNICAMP and UNESP. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


We are seeking a proactive, results-oriented Talent Acquisition Specialist to join our global HR team. In this role, you will drive the hiring of top-tier talent across Europe and APAC, and help us build high-performing teams in both technical and business functions. You will own the end-to-end recruitment process, build and nurture strong talent pipelines, and deliver a fast, high-quality hiring experience that directly contributes to our company’s growth and success worldwide.


Responsibilities:


  • Execute targeted hiring strategies to identify, and hire high-quality talent across sales, technical, and business roles.
  • Proactively source candidates using diverse channels, including job boards, social media, professional networks, referrals, and direct outreach.
  • Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline to support rapid hiring and future growth.
  • Partner closely with hiring managers to understand role requirements, skill needs, and success profiles.
  • Track and report key recruiting metrics (time-to-hire, pipeline quality, candidate conversion rates) to support continuous improvement.
  • Serve as a brand ambassador, ensuring candidates clearly understand the company’s mission, values, and employee experience.
  • Manage the full recruitment lifecycle—sourcing, screening, interviewing, coordinating assessments, and facilitating selection decisions.
  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date candidate data in the applicant tracking system (ATS).


Requirements :


  • A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in talent acquisition, preferably in software or technology companies.
  • Fluent English communication skills.
  • Experience supporting global recruitment, ideally across Europe and APAC.
  • Proficiency with recruiting and sourcing tools such as LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed, and other platforms.
  • Ability to adapt quickly, work independently, and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Ambitious, results-driven, and thrives in high-growth settings.
  • Strong interpersonal, negotiation, and candidate experience skills.


Why Join JoVE?


  • You can expect compensation package competitively placed within the local market
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and in improving student learning in science education
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us

title: Release Manager
description:
About InComm

InComm is a global leader in the payments industry with over 30 years of experience and a presence in 30+ countries. As pioneers in gift cards, we hold two-thirds of the global market share.

Our mission is to revolutionize global commerce through innovative payment technologies for retailers, brands, and consumers.


Job Summary

The Software Release Manager II will plan, coordinate, ensure notifications are sent in a timely manner, and schedule software releases in alignment with organizational strategy and goals. This role works closely with cross-functional teams throughout the software development lifecycle to ensure the quality and timeliness of releases , monitor and report progress during the release windows, and identify areas for improvement through testing feedback. The position also develops reports and metrics to communicate release performance to leadership.

  • Develop and maintain release documentation, including release notes and rollback plans.
  • Produce reports and metrics on release performance and communicate findings to leadership.
  • Ensure compliance with InComm’s release management policies and best practices.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives for release processes.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field preferred.
  • 4+ years of experience in release coordination, change management, or related IT governance roles.
  • Familiarity with SDLC processes and testing practices.

  • Experience with tools such as JIRA, Confluence, ServiceNow, or similar for tracking and documentation.


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Cloud Infrastructure:

  • Compute: Proficiency in managing and optimizing virtual machines, containers, and serverless computing on GCP (e.g., Compute Engine, Kubernetes Engine, Cloud Functions).
  • Networking: In-depth knowledge of VPCs, subnets, firewalls, VPNs, and hybrid connectivity solutions (e.g., Cloud Interconnect, Cloud VPN).
  • Storage: Expertise in various storage solutions, including Cloud Storage, Persistent Disks, Filestore, and database services like Cloud SQL, Bigtable, and Firestore.

Security:

  • Identity and Access Management (IAM): Strong understanding of IAM roles, policies, and best practices for securing cloud resources.
  • Data Protection: Experience with encryption, key management (e.g., Cloud KMS), and data loss prevention (DLP) services.
  • Compliance: Familiarity with compliance standards and implementing security controls to meet regulatory requirements.
  • HashiCorp Vault: Proficiency in using HashiCorp Vault for secrets management, encryption, and access control.

Automation and Scripting:

  • Scripting Languages: Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, Bash, and PowerShell for automating tasks and managing cloud resources.
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Experience with IaC tools like Terraform, Cloud Deployment Manager, and Ansible for provisioning and managing infrastructure.
  • HashiCorp Terraform Enterprise: Expertise in using Terraform Enterprise for infrastructure automation, collaboration, and governance.
  • CI/CD Pipelines: Knowledge of continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) tools and practices (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, Cloud Build).

DevOps and Monitoring:

  • Containerization: Expertise in containerization technologies (e.g., Docker) and orchestration platforms (e.g., Kubernetes).
  • Monitoring and Logging: Proficiency in monitoring and logging tools (e.g., Stackdriver, Prometheus, Grafana) to ensure the health and performance of cloud environments.
  • Incident Management: Experience with incident response and management tools (e.g., PagerDuty, Opsgenie) to handle and resolve issues promptly.

Data and Analytics:

  • Big Data: Knowledge of big data processing and analytics services (e.g., BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc) for handling large-scale data workloads.
  • Machine Learning: Familiarity with machine learning services (e.g., AI Platform, AutoML) and integrating ML models into cloud applications.

  • Manage availability, backup/restore, disaster recovery, and survivability  strategies in Azure SQL 
  • Monitor and proactively address performance bottlenecks, deadlocks, blocking, and resource contention

Azure Cloud & DevOps  

  • Design and operate solutions using Microsoft Azure , with a focus on reliability and observability 
  • Support CI/CD pipelines  and deployment practices using Azure DevOps 
  • Work with monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure system health and rapid issue resolution 
  • Collaborate on infrastructure decisions that impact scalability, performance, and cost 


Required Qualifications  


Experience & Education  

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience 
  • 7+ years  of professional experience in C#/.NET software development 
  • Strong written and spoken English (C1 or C2 proficiency) 


Technical Skills (Priority Order)  

  • Strong SQL Server / Azure SQL expertise , including: 

Advanced T-SQL 

Stored procedures and query optimization 

Indexing strategies and execution plan analysis 

Performance tuning and troubleshooting 

  • Proven experience owning database operations , including: 

Backup, restore, high availability, and disaster recovery 

Performance monitoring and scaling 

Cost and capacity management in Azure 

  • Expert-level proficiency in C#, .NET Core, and .NET Framework  
  • Experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs  
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure services , including App Services, Functions, and Storage
  • Front-end experience with Angular (7–17)

Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities 
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of critical systems 
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality and reliability 
  • Collaborative mindset with experience working in cross-functional, distributed teams 

Bonus Points

  • Strong understanding of DevOps practices  and production operations 
  • Experience working in HIPAA-regulated environments  

What We Offer  

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience 
  • Opportunity to own critical systems  and influence architectural decisions 
  • A collaborative engineering culture that values quality, accountability, and continuous improvement

title: Revenue Operations Specialist
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Revenue Operations Specialist with 3 to 6 years of experience in revenue and sales operations to support our U.S. client's growing go-to-market organization. You will be responsible for managing and improving processes that drive revenue visibility and efficiency, including Salesforce administration, pipeline analytics, quote-to-cash workflows, and services operations coordination.

This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Services, and Systems, ensuring operational excellence across the full customer lifecycle. The ideal candidate is a systems thinker who thrives on process optimization, data accuracy, and cross-functional collaboration.

Our client provides a cloud-based ERP platform to hundreds of energy industry customers, delivering market-leading software solutions for field service management, field data gathering, transportation, production, accounting, and land management. Backed by private equity, our client accelerates business performance, improves operational efficiency, and reduces costs.


Responsibilities


Sales Operations

  • Own and optimize Salesforce processes for the Sales and Account Management teams, including lead management, opportunity tracking, forecasting, and pipeline hygiene
  • Partner with Sales Leadership to develop and maintain dashboards, metrics, and reports that provide visibility into bookings performance, funnel conversion, and forecast accuracy
  • Support commission plan execution by maintaining accurate opportunity data, product configurations, and close dates
  • Coordinate with Finance and Legal on deal review processes, ensuring consistency between quotes, contracts, and billing data

Services Operations

CRM and Systems Administration

  • Serve as the Salesforce (SFDC) administrator for all go-to-market (GTM) functions - including user management, profiles, validation rules, and custom workflows
  • Maintain integrations with related systems to ensure data synchronization and process automation

  • Manage user support requests, troubleshoot data discrepancies, and ensure compliance with data governance standards

Data and Reporting

  • Develop recurring and ad hoc reports to support revenue forecasting, KPI reviews, and board-level insights
  • Audit data for accuracy and completeness across systems; proactively resolve inconsistencies or bottlenecks
  • Partner with finance, sales, and marketing leadership to define and monitor core GTM metrics, including customer acquisition cost (CAC) payback, annual recurring revenue (ARR) growth, churn, and expansion rates.

Contracts

  • Track and respond to internal questions regarding contract terms, pricing, and commercial conditions, partnering closely with Finance and Legal as needed.
  • Support contract lifecycle management by monitoring stated terms and addressing internal stakeholder inquiries to ensure accuracy and compliance.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written skills

  • Strong Excel and reporting skills
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills with a bias for action and detail orientation
  • Must be a self-starter and resourceful
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team
  • Proven experience working effectively in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment

Desired Experience

Requisitos

  • Formação: Nos importamos mais com experiência prática do que formação superior.

Foco em recrutamento estratégico e com entrega rápida/efetiva. Nosso SLA de entrega são 5 dias úteis, e nossa taxa de fechamento é entre 3 - 6 indicados.


Perfil

  • Altamente organizado e orientado a resultados
  • Excelente comunicação interpessoal
  • Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas prioridades em ritmo acelerado
  • Resiliência à pressão e postura hands-on
  • Curioso: Nosso perfil é pesquisar sobre vagas, criar estratégias de hunting ground, conseguir ter base para entrevistar candidatos de forma qualificada.

Infraestrutura

O que não se alinha com o nosso jeito de trabalhar

  • Dificuldade em lidar com ritmo intenso e alta pressão: Nosso dia a dia é acelerado e está em constante transformação. Quem precisa de supervisão constante, tem dificuldade com pressão ou busca um ambiente previsível pode não se adaptar bem aqui.
  • Ausência de senso de responsabilidade e rejeição à autonomia: Esperamos postura de dono: tomar decisões, assumir riscos e gerar resultados. Quem depende de orientação constante ou busca validação o tempo todo provavelmente não terá espaço. Aqui, o protagonismo é essencial e valorizado com participação nos resultados.
  • Resistência a feedbacks francos e cultura de transparência: Prezamos pela clareza e sinceridade. Feedbacks são recorrentes e parte do nosso desenvolvimento. Isso exige maturidade para aceitar críticas construtivas com abertura e humildade.
  • Apego a horários fixos: Somos uma consultoria em expansão acelerada. Problemas surgem a qualquer momento, e as soluções também. Valorizamos quem entrega com excelência mesmo que isso demande flexibilidade de agenda.


Pacote de remuneração

title: Senior Full Stack Web Application Developer (JavaScript, PHP, linux)

title: Customer Success Analyst
description:
About Teachable:

Teachable is trusted by creator-educators around the world to grow their impact and income. From online courses and communities to memberships and downloads, Teachable's digital learning products help creator-educators drive meaningful connection and sustainable revenue. With industry-best ecommerce tools, easily toggled on directly within the platform, creators can confidently maximize their earnings, while getting paid directly by their audience. Teachable's unmatched focus on the student learning experience also ensures creators can make a positive and influential impact on their communities—entirely on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creator-educators use Teachable to share their knowledge, reaching millions of students around the world. To learn more, visit teachable.com.


Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? As part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!


What is the role?

This is a Senior Customer Success Analyst role for someone who operates comfortably without a fixed scope, moves fluidly between strategy and execution, and takes ownership not just of relationships, but of outcomes.


At Teachable, creators are entrepreneurs who build, market, and scale digital education businesses, using our platform as their core operating system. You will own a portfolio of high-potential creators and drive retention, growth, and expansion by acting as a strategic and tactical advisor. This role goes beyond relationship management: you will diagnose business challenges, form a point of view, and deliver clear, actionable recommendations that help creators scale their businesses through product adoption, marketing, and growth strategies.


As our Customer Success model continues to evolve, the scope and engagement approach of your portfolio may change over time. This role is well-suited for someone who is comfortable operating in this context and adjusting priorities thoughtfully as the team scales.


In this role you’ll:

  • Own and manage a portfolio of high-potential creators, where portfolio size, composition, and engagement approach may evolve over time as our Customer Success model continues to take shape.
  • Be accountable for retention and growth outcomes across your portfolio by turning goals into concrete success plans, defining what “good” looks like for each account, and influencing customer decisions through clear recommendations, follow-ups, and next steps.
  • Act as a trusted advisor by diagnosing business problems, forming a point of view, and recommending specific actions related to sales, marketing, monetization, and platform usage. This role requires comfort moving from strategy to tactics (including discussing offers, funnels, launches, pricing, and distribution) and clearly articulating what the customer should do next.
  • Engage directly and hands-on with creators across your portfolio, flexing between high-touch 1:1 support and scalable engagement models as needed. You will help design, run, and iterate on scalable initiatives (e.g. group coaching, campaigns, enablement content) as we continue to evolve our engagement playbooks.
  • Drive product adoption by connecting Teachable’s features and tools to concrete business use cases, helping creators understand what to adopt, when to adopt it, and how it supports their growth.
  • Work cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, PMM, Sales, Support, Data, and Revenue Operations to surface customer insights, align on priorities, and influence decisions that improve the end-to-end creator experience.
  • Actively contribute to the evolution of our Customer Success function by identifying patterns across your portfolio, testing new approaches, documenting what works (and what doesn’t), and translating individual insights into repeatable motions for the broader team.


Must haves:

  • 4+ years of experience owning a book of business in Customer Success, Account Management, Sales, or Business Development, with direct responsibility for retention, expansion, or revenue outcomes, beyond relationship maintenance
  • Experience managing a portfolio where growth was not guaranteed, requiring you to diagnose why accounts were plateauing and to take ownership of changing those outcomes
  • Proven ability to advise customers running complex businesses, with multiple stakeholders and unclear paths to growth, translating ambiguity into clear priorities and execution plans
  • Demonstrated comfort operating across high-touch and scaled engagement models, including knowing when to go deep 1:1 and when to drive impact through programs, campaigns, or enablement
  • Ability to develop a clear point of view, challenge customer assumptions, and influence decisions
  • Track record of turning incomplete data and weak signals into structured action plans, and following through to drive measurable business results
  • Strong analytical skills, with hands-on experience using customer, revenue, and product data to identify risks, opportunities, and concrete levers for growth
  • Practical experience using CRM and analytics tools to actively manage, prioritize, and evolve a portfolio strategy
  • Fluent in English, with confidence leading both strategic and tactical conversations (all of your portfolio will speak english)


Nice to haves:

  • Experience working with founders, creators, or entrepreneurs who own both strategy and execution of their businesses
  • Background in growth, monetization, or go-to-market strategy, particularly in digital or SaaS businesses
  • Experience designing, running, or iterating on scaled Customer Success motions (programs, group coaching, campaigns, enablement) alongside 1:1 engagement


You’ll be a great fit for this role if you:

  • Enjoy a proactive, growth-oriented Customer Success role , where you go beyond relationship maintenance and actively identify opportunities to drive customer impact
  • Thrive in a dynamic environment , managing evolving portfolios and adapting your engagement approach as customer needs change
  • Prefer working with autonomy and judgment , using your experience to make decisions rather than relying solely on rigid playbooks


This is a CLT contract with full benefits, paid in $BRL.


Teachable encourages individuals from a broad diversity of backgrounds to apply for positions. We are an equal opportunity employer, meaning we're committed to a fair and consistent interview process. Please tell us in your application if you require an accommodation to apply for a job or to perform your job.

title: PMO TI Trilingue \"#988548\"
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar como PMO do projeto, garantindo o cumprimento de cronograma, escopo, orçamento e qualidade.
  • Coordenar reuniões de status, comitês de projeto e comunicação entre times locais e globais.
  • Gerenciar riscos, dependências e planos de mitigação.
  • Garantir alinhamento entre requisitos legais e operacionais dos países envolvidos.
  • Apoiar na gestão de fornecedores e parceiros envolvidos na implementação.
  • Consolidar e reportar indicadores de progresso e entregas.

title: Engenheiro de Software Pleno PJ (Ruby on Rails)
description:
O Grupo Smart Fit é muito mais do que a maior rede de academias da América Latina e o maior empregador de profissionais de educação física do mundo. Somos um verdadeiro ecossistema focado em bem-estar e saúde, impactando a vida de milhares de pessoas todos os dias.


Estamos em mais de 15 países, com mais de 1.800 unidades, e temos o prazer de atender mais de 5,2 milhões de alunos. Nossa equipe de 15 mil colaboradores está sempre a mil, trazendo novas ideias e inovações. Desde que abrimos nossa capital em 2021, aceleramos nossa missão de transformar vidas com soluções de fitness e saúde.


Temos várias marcas no nosso portfólio, como Bio Ritmo, Smart Fit, Race Bootcamp, Vidya Studio, Jab House, Tonus Gym, One Pilates, Velocity, Kore TotalPass e Nation CT. Além disso, oferecemos produtos digitais como Queima Diária, Smart Fit Nutri e Smart Fit Coach. Estamos sempre procurando novas formas de integrar tecnologia e inovação para ajudar você a ter um estilo de vida mais ativo e saudável. E aí, topa o desafio junto com a gente?


O que nos move todos os dias?

Somos parte da mudança, transformando o cenário e trazendo mais qualidade para a vida de quem tá junto com a gente. Cada gotinha de suor é uma prova do nosso compromisso em inspirar e motivar todo mundo que quer uma vida mais ativa e saudável. A cada dia, começamos nossa jornada com aquecimento total, prontos para alcançar novos objetivos e viver o máximo.


O Engenheiro de Software Pleno PJ (Ruby on Rails) será responsável por:

1. Desenvolvimento e Entrega Técnica

  • Construção da API Core: Desenvolver e manter endpoints RESTful eficientes utilizando Ruby on Rails para suportar as aplicações Web e Mobile.
  • Escrita de Testes Automatizados: Garantir a estabilidade do sistema através de testes de integração e unitários (RSpec), utilizando VCR e WebMock para garantir que as dependências externas não atrasem o pipeline.
  • Otimização de Performance: Garantir que a API seja rápida e escalável, aplicando boas práticas de banco de dados (PostgreSQL) e evitando gargalos de processamento.


2. Integração e Homologação (Foco em Qualidade)

  • Validação de Integração: Testar e homologar ativamente as interações da API com o desenvolvimento Front-end (Web e Mobile), garantindo que os dados trafegados estejam corretos e performáticos.
  • Garantia de Eficiência: Assegurar a máxima qualidade no processo de integração, antecipando falhas de contrato de dados e garantindo que as funcionalidades atendam aos requisitos de UI/UX de ambos os clientes.
  • Definição de Contratos: Colaborar no desenho técnico prévio dos endpoints para garantir que o time de Front-end tenha mocks funcionais e especificações claras, minimizando o retrabalho.


3. Colaboração e Alinhamento

  • Gestão de Bloqueios: Atuar de forma proativa para identificar e comunicar impedimentos técnicos que possam impactar o cronograma de 3 meses.
  • Code Review: Participar de revisões de código focadas em manter o padrão de qualidade da equipe e a consistência do \"Rails Way\".


4. Aprendizado e Melhoria Contínua

  • Evolução Profissional: Manter-se atualizado com as novas versões do Ruby e do Rails, trazendo as melhores práticas de segurança e arquitetura para o projeto a longo prazo.
  • Aprimoramento de Processos: Analisar constantemente o ciclo de desenvolvimento e propor melhorias que tornem o fluxo de deploy e a integração com o front-end mais ágeis.


5. Documentação e Sustentabilidade

  • Documentação Técnica: Manter uma documentação clara e atualizada da API (ex: Swagger/OpenAPI) para servir como fonte única de verdade para os times de consumo.
  • Manutenibilidade: Equilibrar o pragmatismo da entrega rápida com a saúde do código, garantindo uma base sólida para a evolução permanente do produto.


Itens essenciais que não podem faltar no seu kit:

  • Ruby on Rails (Modo API): Domínio profundo do framework, priorizando o \"Rails Way\" e o uso de scaffolding eficiente para velocidade de entrega.
  • Design de API RESTful: Experiência em estruturar endpoints que atendam simultaneamente Web e Mobile (JSON, paginação, versionamento).
  • Testes e Mocking (RSpec): Domínio de VCR e WebMock para simular interações externas de forma determinística, garantindo uma suíte de testes rápida e confiável.
  • Modelagem de Dados: Experiência com PostgreSQL e uso eficiente de Active Record (evitando o problema de N+1).
  • Autenticação e Segurança: Implementação prática de JWT ou Devise Token Auth.
  • Pragmatismo e Foco: Foco em resolver o problema de negócio com a solução mais simples e direta, evitando \"overengineering\".
  • Comunicação Proativa e Colaboração: Habilidade de alinhar contratos de API antecipadamente com os times de Front-end e Mobile para evitar bloqueios e garantir que a integração seja fluida.
  • Antecipação de Riscos (Atitude Dono): Capacidade de identificar gargalos ou requisitos ambíguos precocemente, levantando a mão e propondo soluções para evitar retrabalhos.
  • Trabalho em Equipe: Mentalidade colaborativa, compartilhando conhecimento e garantindo que o código seja legível e mantível para o restante do time.
  • Autonomia: Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas alinhadas às convenções do Rails sem necessidade de microgerenciamento.


Diferencial (IA): Uso de ferramentas como GitHub Copilot ou Cursor para acelerar a escrita de código e geração de mocks de dados.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale.   • AI Risk Mitigation : Address vulnerabilities unique to AI, such as model drift, bias exploitation, adversarial robustness, and hallucination control with sensitivity to regulated environments
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Partner with software engineers, data specialists, and security teams to integrate AI capabilities into the broader client OS, embedding AI by design into every product release
  • Speed of Delivery : Operate with urgency, delivering breakthroughs in code and AI services on cycles measured in weeks, not quarters.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of applied ML/AI engineering experience, ideally with exposure to enterprise/mission-critical systems.

Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, XILO set out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Eli, a brokerage owner, brought invaluable industry expertise, while Jon, an experienced software engineer, saw an opportunity to innovate using technology.

The Mission

We are looking for a Senior Engineer to replace a key member of our technical team. You will be joining a group working on a revolutionary product designed to completely transform the United States Insurance Industry. This is not just a standard CRUD application; we are building complex workflows involving AI agents and browser-based tooling to modernize a legacy industry.


The Role

You will act as a Full Stack Developer with a heavy emphasis on Backend and AI logic. While Python is your primary weapon for new development, you must be versatile enough to tune existing Node.js services and handle frontend requirements in Angular and Chrome Extensions.

We are looking for someone who understands Agentic Workflows —how to organize AI models to perform complex tasks—not just someone who knows how to make a simple API call to OpenAI.


Key Responsibilities

  • AI & Backend Architecture: Design and implement robust backend services using Python. You will lead the development of AI Agents, defining how they interact, manage context, and execute tasks.
  • Browser-Based Innovation : Maintain and expand our core Chrome Extension product. This is a critical interface for our users.
  • Service Tuning: Interface with and optimize existing microservices written in Node.js . You don’t need to be a Node expert, but you must be comfortable reading, debugging, and tuning this code.
  • Frontend Maintenance: implement UI/UX features using Angular . While the role is backend-heavy, you should be comfortable jumping into the frontend to ship complete features.
  • Light Infrastructure: Handle very basic deployment or configuration tasks (DevOps is not a primary duty, but “infrastructure awareness” is required).


What we’re looking for

  • Seniority: 5+ years of commercial software development experience.
  • Python Mastery: Deep experience with Python for backend development.
  • AI/Agent Experience: proven experience working with LLMs and AI Agents. You understand the architecture of agentic frameworks (loops, memory, tools).
  • Note: Specific framework knowledge (LangChain, CrewAI) is a plus, but a strong conceptual grasp of how agents are organized is mandatory.
  • Node.js Proficiency: Ability to read, understand, and patch Node.js environments.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with LangChain or CrewAI .
  • Experience building or maintaining complex browser extensions (manifest v3, background scripts, content injection).
  • Previous experience in the InsurTech or Fintech sectors.
  • Background in modernizing legacy workflows with automation.
  • Familiarity with Angular .


Why Join Us?

  • Impact: Work on a product that is actively changing how the US insurance market operates.
  • Cutting Edge Tech: We are not just talking about AI; we are implementing agentic workflows in production.
  • Remote Culture: Work from anywhere with a team that values output over hours.

title: PhD Peer Reviewer needed: Professor of Clinical Medicine
description:

WHAT YOU NEED to Have

  • Doctorate PhD or equivalent advanced degree in the subject area

  • Thorough understanding of research methodologies and ethical principles within the relevant discipline
  • Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills
  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to provide clear, concise, and constructive feedback
  • Ability to adhere to deadlines and manage time effectively
  • Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and objectivity
  • Prior experience as a peer reviewer for academic journals is highly desirable
  • Familiarity with online manuscript submission and review systems


WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Assess Novelty: Evaluate whether the manuscript is original and adds new knowledge or insights to the field of study.
  • Evaluate Study Design and Methodology: Check whether the study design and methods are appropriate, comprehensive, and clearly described to ensure reproducibility.
  • Literature Review: Ensure the manuscript thoroughly incorporates and cites relevant, up-to-date research in the field.
  • Analyse Results and Conclusions: Determine whether results are presented clearly and appropriately, and whether conclusions are supported by the data and significant to the field.
  • Provide Constructive Feedback: Suggest improvements and highlight any flaws, omissions, or ethical concerns.
  • Recommend Publication: Based on your evaluation, the journal editor will decide whether the manuscript should be accepted, revised, or rejected.

title: German-Speaking Freelance Customer Support – E-Bike Specialist (Remote Worldwide)

Benefits

title: Especialista em Kafka & CDC (Debezium)
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional especialista em Apache Kafka e Change Data Capture (CDC) com Debezium , para atuar na administração, operação e evolução de ambientes críticos de streaming de dados em produção. O(a) profissional será responsável por garantir alta disponibilidade, escalabilidade, observabilidade e confiabilidade das plataformas de mensageria e CDC.


Irá atuar para um cliente sediado em Portugal

Responsabilidades

  • Administrar ambientes Apache Kafka em produção , incluindo instalação, upgrades, expansão de clusters e troubleshooting.
  • Operar e otimizar clusters Kafka em ambientes Kubernetes , utilizando Operators como Strimzi ou Confluent for Kubernetes (CFK) .
  • Gerenciar e automatizar deploys, upgrades e configurações via CRDs .
  • Implementar e manter soluções de Change Data Capture (CDC) utilizando Debezium , normalmente integrado ao Kafka Connect .
  • Criar, configurar, ajustar (tuning) e monitorar conectores Debezium.
  • Atuar na observabilidade e operação do ecossistema Kafka, garantindo estabilidade e performance.
  • Apoiar times de engenharia na definição de boas práticas de streaming e CDC.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação em modelo remoto no fuso horario de Portugal


Requisitos Técnicos – Kafka

  • Experiência prática sólida com Apache Kafka em produção .
  • Conhecimento de diferentes distribuições de Kafka:
  • Apache Kafka (open source)
  • Confluent Platform / Confluent Cloud
  • Kafka Operators (Strimzi, CFK)
  • Capacidade de avaliar vantagens e desvantagens entre as distribuições (lock-in, custos, features enterprise, etc.).
  • Domínio de conceitos fundamentais:
  • Partições
  • Replicação
  • Consumer Groups
  • Offsets
  • Experiência com Kafka em Kubernetes , incluindo operação via Operators.
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de observabilidade e operação :
  • Prometheus
  • Grafana
  • Confluent Control Center
  • Kafka UI ou similares


Requisitos Técnicos – Debezium e CDC

  • Experiência prática em Debezium como solução de CDC.
  • Atuação com Kafka Connect , incluindo:
  • Criação e configuração de conectores
  • Tuning de performance
  • Monitoramento e troubleshooting
  • Conhecimento dos principais conectores Debezium:
  • MySQL
  • PostgreSQL
  • Oracle
  • SQL Server


Diferenciais

  • Experiência em ambientes de alta escala e missão crítica.
  • Conhecimento em arquiteturas orientadas a eventos.
  • Vivência com ambientes cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
  • Conhecimento em segurança aplicada a Kafka e Kafka Connect.


O que oferecemos

  • Atuação em projetos estratégicos e de alta complexidade técnica.
  • Ambiente colaborativo e focado em excelência técnica.
  • Oportunidade de crescimento e especialização em streaming e dados em tempo real.

  • Experience building internal developer platforms , ideally using frameworks like Backstage .

  • Experience developing modular, reusable infrastructure templates to enable scalable and consistent resource provisioning.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills; fluent in English (advanced) .


You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Build and evolve the internal developer platform , enabling engineering teams to self-serve infrastructure and deployments efficiently.
  • Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions , ensuring secure, automated delivery across services.
  • Define and maintain Infrastructure as Code modules that enforce best practices and support multi-service deployments at scale.
  • Create reusable infrastructure templates for provisioning environments like ECS , based on dynamic developer inputs.
  • Automate resource provisioning workflows , including conditional logic and default resource allocation.
  • Develop self-service tools and dashboards that reduce support tickets and empower development teams.
  • Contribute to the evolution of the platform by continuously implementing updates and integrating new cloud-native technologies.
  • Collaborate with security and compliance teams to integrate guardrails and standards into platform tooling.
  • Support internal adoption of Backstage or similar developer portal frameworks to centralize resources and documentation.
  • Drive initiatives to reduce manual operations and increase developer velocity through automation and platform reliability.

title: Production Supervisor/Coordinator - Dry-Mix Mortar & Water-based Coatings Factory
description:
Core Responsibilities:

1. Production Operations & Management

  • Oversee daily production management for both dry-mix mortar and water-based coatings lines. Schedule production tasks according to plan, ensuring production targets are met on time, in quantity, and to quality standards.
  • Supervise the entire production process from material preparation, feeding, and mixing to packaging and palletizing, ensuring smooth and efficient operations at all stages.
  • Strictly execute the production schedule, optimize production cycle times, and improve equipment utilization and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE).

2. Team Management & Development

  • Manage daily shift operations, including personnel scheduling, task assignment, work guidance, and on-site discipline supervision.
  • Organize and implement job skill training to enhance team members' operational skills, quality awareness, and safety mindset.
  • Conduct performance evaluations for shift personnel, providing continuous feedback and coaching to build a high-performance team.

3. Quality Management & Control

  • Strictly enforce standard operating procedures and work instructions to ensure process standardization and stability.
  • Monitor in-line product quality, perform regular checks at key quality control points, and prevent the occurrence of batch quality issues.
  • Collaborate with the Quality department to analyze, address, and track quality deviations in production, and implement corrective and preventive actions.

4. Safety Production & 5S Management

  • Act as the primary safety responsible person for the shift, implementing company safety rules and regulations, organizing safety training, and conducting hazard identification.
  • Ensure all employees strictly adhere to safe operating procedures, particularly those related to dust explosion prevention and chemical handling, to eliminate safety accidents.
  • Promote and maintain 5S management in the production area, creating a clean, orderly, and safe working environment.

5. Cost Control & Continuous Improvement

  • Monitor and analyze the consumption of raw materials, energy, and auxiliary supplies, striving to reduce production costs.
  • Assist in analyzing equipment failure causes to reduce unplanned downtime.
  • Proactively identify waste in the production process, actively participate in and lead continuous improvement activities (e.g., Kaizen), and propose合理化建议 (rationalization suggestions).

Mandatory Requirements:

  • College diploma or above in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Inorganic Non-metallic Materials, or related fields.
  • Minimum 5 years of production experience in the building materials industry, including at least 2 years in a Production Team Leader or Supervisor role. Must have production management experience in a dry-mix mortar or water-based coatings factory.
  • Familiar with the production processes, equipment principles, and operational procedures for dry-mix mortar/coatings (e.g., mixers, automatic packing machines, powder conveying systems, liquid mixing & dispersing equipment).
  • Strong team leadership, communication, coordination, and on-site problem-solving skills.
  • Strong quality awareness, cost consciousness, and safety mindset.
  • Ability to adapt to a factory work environment and handle work pressure.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior work experience with Sika or Saint-Gobain is highly preferred.

title: Production Supervisor/Coordinator - Dry-Mix Mortar & Water-Based Coatings Factory
description:
Core Responsibilities:
1. Production Operations & Management
Oversee daily production management for both dry-mix mortar and water-based coatings lines. Schedule production tasks according to plan, ensuring production targets are met on time, in quantity, and to quality standards.
Supervise the entire production process from material preparation, feeding, and mixing to packaging and palletizing, ensuring smooth and efficient operations at all stages.
Strictly execute the production schedule, optimize production cycle times, and improve equipment utilization and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE).
2. Team Management & Development
Manage daily shift operations, including personnel scheduling, task assignment, work guidance, and on-site discipline supervision.
Organize and implement job skill training to enhance team members' operational skills, quality awareness, and safety mindset.
Conduct performance evaluations for shift personnel, providing continuous feedback and coaching to build a high-performance team.
3. Quality Management & Control
Strictly enforce standard operating procedures and work instructions to ensure process standardization and stability.
Monitor in-line product quality, perform regular checks at key quality control points, and prevent the occurrence of batch quality issues.
Collaborate with the Quality department to analyze, address, and track quality deviations in production, and implement corrective and preventive actions.
4. Safety Production & 5S Management
Act as the primary safety responsible person for the shift, implementing company safety rules and regulations, organizing safety training, and conducting hazard identification.
Ensure all employees strictly adhere to safe operating procedures, particularly those related to dust explosion prevention and chemical handling, to eliminate safety accidents.
Promote and maintain 5S management in the production area, creating a clean, orderly, and safe working environment.
5. Cost Control & Continuous Improvement
Monitor and analyze the consumption of raw materials, energy, and auxiliary supplies, striving to reduce production costs.
Assist in analyzing equipment failure causes to reduce unplanned downtime.
Proactively identify waste in the production process, actively participate in and lead continuous improvement activities (e.G., Kaizen), and propose合理化建议 (rationalization suggestions).
Mandatory Requirements:
College diploma or above in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Inorganic Non-metallic Materials, or related fields.
Minimum 5 years of production experience in the building materials industry, including at least 2 years in a Production Team Leader or Supervisor role. Must have production management experience in a dry-mix mortar or water-based coatings factory.
Familiar with the production processes, equipment principles, and operational procedures for dry-mix mortar/coatings (e.G., mixers, automatic packing machines, powder conveying systems, liquid mixing & dispersing equipment).
Strong team leadership, communication, coordination, and on-site problem-solving skills.
Strong quality awareness, cost consciousness, and safety mindset.
Ability to adapt to a factory work environment and handle work pressure.
Preferred Qualifications:
Prior work experience with Sika or Saint-Gobain is highly preferred.

Elaboração de Relatórios Gerenciais: Preparar apresentações e relatórios periódicos, traduzindo dados financeiros em insights que orientem a alta gestão nas tomadas de decisão.

title: Gerente de Serviços de Aplicações SAP
description:
Resumo da vaga
Estamos em busca de um
Application Service Manager (SAP)
experiente para atuar na gestão de aplicações corporativas, garantindo a estabilidade, desempenho e governança dos sistemas em um ambiente complexo e global.
O profissional será responsável por supervisionar o ciclo de vida das aplicações, gestão de fornecedores, controle de custos operacionais (OPEX) e conformidade com políticas de segurança e governança de TI.
Esta função exige forte capacidade de coordenação entre times técnicos e de negócio, experiência com ambiente SAP e tecnologias corporativas, além de habilidade para atuar em ambientes altamente regulados e orientados por SLAs.
Principais responsabilidades
Gestão de aplicações:
Gerenciar o ciclo de vida das aplicações, incluindo monitoramento, tratamento de incidentes, manutenção e descontinuação de sistemas.
Governança e desempenho:
Definir e acompanhar KPIs e SLAs, garantindo a continuidade do negócio e a excelência na entrega de serviços.
Segurança e conformidade:
Assegurar que as aplicações estejam em conformidade com políticas de segurança da informação, proteção de dados e auditorias internas/externas.
Gestão de fornecedores:
Atuar como ponto focal na relação com fornecedores e prestadores de serviço, monitorando SLAs contratuais e conduzindo renovações.
Gestão financeira (OPEX):
Controlar orçamento, custos operacionais, previsões financeiras e identificar oportunidades de otimização de custos.
Gestão de mudanças:
Supervisionar a implantação de releases, patches e atualizações, assegurando a execução correta dos processos de change management.
Colaboração técnica:
Trabalhar em conjunto com áreas de arquitetura, segurança, times DevOps e "Function Towers" para garantir prontidão operacional antes do go-live.
Requisitos e qualificações
Experiência em TI:
Mínimo de 5 a 7 anos de experiência em Operações de TI ou Gestão de Aplicações em ambientes corporativos de grande porte.
Conhecimento em SAP:
Vivência em ambientes com SAP (ECC ou S/4HANA) e entendimento de integrações entre módulos e sistemas.
Governança de serviços:
Conhecimento sólido em ITIL, gestão de SLAs, KPIs e boas práticas de gestão de serviços de TI.
Gestão de fornecedores:
Experiência com gestão de contratos, acompanhamento de performance e negociação de melhorias de serviço.
Conhecimentos técnicos:
Familiaridade com Azure, Microsoft Power Platform, Dataverse, ferramentas de monitoramento (Datadog, Grafana) e sistemas de chamados (ex.: ServiceNow) será um diferencial.
Idiomas:
Inglês avançado é essencial.
Perfil comportamental:
Fortes habilidades de comunicação, organização, visão analítica e capacidade de trabalhar com múltiplos stakeholders.

title: Cozinheiro
description:
️

segundo cozinheiro

segundo cozinheiro
para
primeiro cozinheiro
e depois
líder de cozinha

Suas principais responsabilidades
Executar e finalizar pratos conforme o padrão de qualidade da casa.
Manter o ambiente limpo, organizado e seguro.
Seguir as fichas técnicas e boas práticas de manipulação.
Apoiar o controle de estoque e armazenamento dos insumos.
Colaborar com a equipe e garantir ritmo e harmonia na operação.
O que esperamos de você
Experiência em cozinha quente.
Comprometimento e respeito pelos colegas e processos.
Vontade de aprender e crescer junto com a equipe.
Disponibilidade para atuar em Campinas/SP.
O que oferecemos
Escala
5x2
e
jornada dupla
.
Folga no final do ano
entre Natal e Ano Novo.
Refeição no local.
Seguro de vida Porto Seguro.
Antecipação da 1a parcela do 13o
no mês do aniversário.
Bônus de desempenho anual:
um salário adicional se a meta anual da empresa for atingida.
Treinamento direto com o chef Mauro Mason.
Plano de crescimento interno
com acompanhamento constante.
Remuneração compatível com o mercado.

Se você acredita que cozinhar é mais do que preparar pratos — é
cuidar de pessoas
—, queremos te conhecer.
Envie seu currículo e venha fazer parte da
Família Benedito

  • Estrutura de Marketing e Eventos para auxiliar na prospecção de clientes.

title: Executivo Comercial - Hunter para Grandes Contas - Mercado Pago
description:
No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito!
Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.
Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico, para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.
Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques. Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.
Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:
Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.
Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão.

title: Analista Comercial Sênior
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.
A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.
Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.
E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.
Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Acompanhar e analisar o orçamento e o planejamento comercial, utilizando ferramentas de controle e gestão, assegurando o cumprimento do planejamento anual e dos resultados do Shopping;
Conduzir negociações comerciais com lojistas, incluindo renovações, retenções, movimentações estratégicas e discussões contratuais, garantindo a sustentabilidade do mix e a performance comercial;
Atuar na gestãojurídica contratual, em interface com as áreas responsáveis, assegurando conformidade, prazos e mitigação de riscos;
Consolidar, analisar e garantir a confiabilidade das informações de NOI, bem como dos principais KPIs comerciais, por meio de análises críticas e relatórios gerenciais;

title: Engenheiro mecânico (PJ)
description:
Mechanical Engineering (PJ - Design Bens de Consumo)
Looking for:
We are looking for a motivated and hands-on Mechanical Engineer to join our team. This position
will provide you with the opportunity to work on exciting development projects, helping to create and
bring innovative products to life. You will apply your experience in mechanical design, CAD modeling,
prototyping, while working alongside cross-functional teams to ensure the product meets all
requirements from concept to production.
The Mechanical Engineer Reporting to the Staff (USA), Engineer out of Campinas.
The Candidate:
You have experience engineering new products and/or handling touchpoints throughout the
concept to manufacturing journey. You've either built or supported bringing new products to the
world, handling mechanical engineering design, research, testing, prototyping, and validation.
You have experience working with mass manufactured product and are familiar with a variety of
materials. You're willing to research, learn, adapt and take initiative but not afraid of taking on
challenges.
The Qualifications
:
3+ years of experience in product development and mechanical engineering. Must have a portfolio with previously launched and manufactured products.
Proven experience within consumer electronics /household appliance industry and related industries focused on mechanical engineering
Engineering degree preferably Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
Highly proficient and deeply familiar with CAD tools (Solidworks, Onshape, or Creo) and prior experience with a variety of prototyping approaches
Hands-on experience with prototyping, 3D printing, or other fabrication tools is a plus.
Experience with a wide range of materials (plastics, metals, rubbers) and knowledge informing the material selection process.
Problem-solving mindset: Ability to approach challenges methodically applying analytical skills with proactive issue resolution- creating and guiding root cause analysis and DOE's.
Passion for product development: Interest in consumer product design, manufacturing, and mechanical systems.
Strong communication skills: Ability to work well with cross-functional teams and convey technical concepts clearly. Strong Presentation skills - especially conveying technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
Excellent project management skills- with experience tracking numerous development projects simultaneously.
Ability to travel to Asia including Hong Kong, China, Vietnam, South Korea, and Taiwan.
Ability to work in English
The Job:
As Mechanical Engineer, you will:
Help to lead (and lead) development work from product definition through manufacturing.
Communicate progress to team members and project requirements for development and manufacturing.
Work closely with NYC and Asia teams to communicate and determine direction & solve development problems as they arise.
Collaborate with NY/Asia engineering teams to ensure the engineering designs meet client requirements and design intent.
The Responsibilities:
Assist and lead Mechanical Design: Support the design and development of product by creating 3D CAD models, producing engineering drawings, and necessary documentation. i.e. lead mechanical design engineering of a product from inception to manufacturing.
Prototyping & Testing: Build and test prototypes to validate designs, including hands-on assembly and working with external suppliers for prototype development.
Ensure efficient product development cycle with detailed prototyping, testing, and validation throughout the process.
Ensuring designs align with performance, material, and cost targets determined for each project.
Collaborate with Teams: Work closely with the engineering and design teams to ensure that products meet functional, material, and aesthetic goals. Communicate with marketing, operations, and manufacturing teams to align on project updates and requirements.
Support and Create Documentation: Assist with maintaining and updating CAD models and related product documentation (3D, 2D, etc.).
Product Testing: Help conduct off-tool and in-market sample testing, participate in troubleshooting and debugging design issues, and recommend improvements.
Learn from Experienced Engineers: Continue to build experience in various materials and different stages of product development while learning best practices from senior and staff engineers.
Support Supply Chain Efforts: Collaborate with the sourcing and supply chain teams to help gather information and support procurement of materials and components.
Providing technical feedback and assets to support sourcing & supply chain teams, working closely with manufacturing engineers and suppliers.
Handle multiple projects and work independently.
Provide Engineering Support and Analysis to NY and HK engineering teams.
Build inhouse prototypes or scope external partners to prototype designs.

title: Production Supervisor/Coordinator - Dry-Mix Mortar & Water-Based Coatings Factory
description:
Core Responsibilities:

1. Production Operations & Management

  • Oversee daily production management for both dry-mix mortar and water-based coatings lines. Schedule production tasks according to plan, ensuring production targets are met on time, in quantity, and to quality standards.
  • Supervise the entire production process from material preparation, feeding, and mixing to packaging and palletizing, ensuring smooth and efficient operations at all stages.
  • Strictly execute the production schedule, optimize production cycle times, and improve equipment utilization and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE).

2. Team Management & Development

  • Manage daily shift operations, including personnel scheduling, task assignment, work guidance, and on-site discipline supervision.
  • Organize and implement job skill training to enhance team members' operational skills, quality awareness, and safety mindset.
  • Conduct performance evaluations for shift personnel, providing continuous feedback and coaching to build a high-performance team.

3. Quality Management & Control

  • Strictly enforce standard operating procedures and work instructions to ensure process standardization and stability.
  • Monitor in-line product quality, perform regular checks at key quality control points, and prevent the occurrence of batch quality issues.
  • Collaborate with the Quality department to analyze, address, and track quality deviations in production, and implement corrective and preventive actions.

4. Safety Production & 5S Management

  • Act as the primary safety responsible person for the shift, implementing company safety rules and regulations, organizing safety training, and conducting hazard identification.
  • Ensure all employees strictly adhere to safe operating procedures, particularly those related to dust explosion prevention and chemical handling, to eliminate safety accidents.
  • Promote and maintain 5S management in the production area, creating a clean, orderly, and safe working environment.

5. Cost Control & Continuous Improvement

  • Monitor and analyze the consumption of raw materials, energy, and auxiliary supplies, striving to reduce production costs.
  • Assist in analyzing equipment failure causes to reduce unplanned downtime.
  • Proactively identify waste in the production process, actively participate in and lead continuous improvement activities (e.G., Kaizen), and propose合理化建议 (rationalization suggestions).

Mandatory Requirements:

  • College diploma or above in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Inorganic Non-metallic Materials, or related fields.
  • Minimum 5 years of production experience in the building materials industry, including at least 2 years in a Production Team Leader or Supervisor role. Must have production management experience in a dry-mix mortar or water-based coatings factory.
  • Familiar with the production processes, equipment principles, and operational procedures for dry-mix mortar/coatings (e.G., mixers, automatic packing machines, powder conveying systems, liquid mixing & dispersing equipment).
  • Strong team leadership, communication, coordination, and on-site problem-solving skills.
  • Strong quality awareness, cost consciousness, and safety mindset.
  • Ability to adapt to a factory work environment and handle work pressure.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior work experience with Sika or Saint-Gobain is highly preferred.

Esta função exige forte capacidade de coordenação entre times técnicos e de negócio, experiência com ambiente SAP e tecnologias corporativas, além de habilidade para atuar em ambientes altamente regulados e orientados por SLAs.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Gestão de aplicações:

Gerenciar o ciclo de vida das aplicações, incluindo monitoramento, tratamento de incidentes, manutenção e descontinuação de sistemas.

  • Governança e desempenho:

Definir e acompanhar KPIs e SLAs, garantindo a continuidade do negócio e a excelência na entrega de serviços.

  • Segurança e conformidade:

Assegurar que as aplicações estejam em conformidade com políticas de segurança da informação, proteção de dados e auditorias internas/externas.

  • Gestão de fornecedores:

Atuar como ponto focal na relação com fornecedores e prestadores de serviço, monitorando SLAs contratuais e conduzindo renovações.

  • Gestão financeira (OPEX):

Controlar orçamento, custos operacionais, previsões financeiras e identificar oportunidades de otimização de custos.

  • Gestão de mudanças:

Supervisionar a implantação de releases, patches e atualizações, assegurando a execução correta dos processos de change management.

  • Colaboração técnica:

Trabalhar em conjunto com áreas de arquitetura, segurança, times DevOps e “Function Towers” para garantir prontidão operacional antes do go-live.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência em TI: Mínimo de 5 a 7 anos de experiência em Operações de TI ou Gestão de Aplicações em ambientes corporativos de grande porte.
  • Conhecimento em SAP: Vivência em ambientes com SAP (ECC ou S/4HANA) e entendimento de integrações entre módulos e sistemas.
  • Governança de serviços: Conhecimento sólido em ITIL, gestão de SLAs, KPIs e boas práticas de gestão de serviços de TI.
  • Gestão de fornecedores: Experiência com gestão de contratos, acompanhamento de performance e negociação de melhorias de serviço.
  • Conhecimentos técnicos: Familiaridade com Azure, Microsoft Power Platform, Dataverse, ferramentas de monitoramento (Datadog, Grafana) e sistemas de chamados (ex.: ServiceNow) será um diferencial.
  • Idiomas: Inglês avançado é essencial.
  • Perfil comportamental: Fortes habilidades de comunicação, organização, visão analítica e capacidade de trabalhar com múltiplos stakeholders.
